description: This Java class represents an archive record for HL7 messages that have been processed and stored in the system, extending HL7QueueItem and integrating with Hibernate Envers for auditing.

classes.name: HL7InArchive
classes.description: Represents a successfully processed HL7 message archive, extending HL7QueueItem, with fields for archive ID, message state, and load status, and supporting Hibernate auditing.

methods.name: HL7InArchive
methods.description: Constructor that creates an HL7InArchive instance from an existing HL7InQueue object, copying relevant source data and setting the message status to processed.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the archive record.

methods.name: setHL7InArchiveId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the archive record.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for the archive, implementing OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the archive, implementing OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Returns whether HL7 data has been loaded from the filesystem.

methods.name: setLoaded
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether HL7 data has been loaded.
